desert_slime:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix ONLY sprite-sheet spacing/padding of the supplied 史萊姆 desert_slime sheet. Preserve the character design, palette, equipment, LEFT-facing camera, all 24 articulated poses, exact 6-column x 4-row order (idle, move, attack, death), and true transparency.
Some poses currently touch neighbors or outer canvas edges. Make every pose uniformly about 35% SMALLER inside its cell, using the SAME reduction for all 24 poses. Re-center EACH individual frame within its OWN equal-width column and equal-height row. Every single full silhouette, tail, weapon tip, ear and corpse MUST fit within the central 60% of cell WIDTH; leave AT LEAST 20% of cell width CLEAR TRANSPARENT on BOTH LEFT AND RIGHT of every frame. Each separate character must have a large transparent gap around it on all sides. In particular reconstruct any previously cut-off tail tip/weapon so it is fully visible. No two frames touching or overlapping. Ground baseline consistent at 86% of each cell height, including all final death corpses. Keep poses and body size consistent across rows; do not shrink just the attack or death row.
Do NOT make one smaller 6x4 sheet floating inside the old sheet; distribute the 24 smaller individual characters evenly over the whole same six-by-four canvas, with more empty space BETWEEN EACH pair. Keep the actual articulated pose differences. No cropping, no missing feet, no extra frame, no text, no lines, no grid, no shadow, no backdrop, no new effects. Output only this corrected transparent 24-frame sprite sheet.
